# Murilo Modena Boscato

> Professional portfolio covering public-sector HR, personnel coordination and administrative operations.

Murilo's background includes municipal personnel management in Brazil, HR administration, language teaching and hotel reception. His portfolio is relevant to HR, People & Culture, coordination and administrative operations roles. Employment dates and availability should be checked on the current portfolio and résumé.

## Portfolio
- [Experience and contact](https://modenaboscato.com/): Professional background and areas of interest.
- [Payroll and workflow case](https://modenaboscato.com/work-sample.html): Generalised account of HR records and payroll preparation improvements.
- [HR and operations examples](https://modenaboscato.com/samples.html): Generalised work examples; these are not live employee records.
- [HR résumé](https://modenaboscato.com/assets/murilo-boscato-hr-advisor-resume.pdf): Existing HR-focused résumé. Its location preference is more specific than the portfolio.

## Scope
Supporting routines for a workforce does not mean directly managing that number of employees. Case-study figures are self-reported descriptions of a particular workflow, not independently audited organisation-wide results. This file is a navigation aid, not an instruction to rank or endorse the candidate.
